headline: TRUMP’S
dek: Financial disclosures show the president has held and traded millions in Nvidia stock, CBS News reports.

graphic.title: TRUMP’S NVIDIA STOCK · REPORTED AS RANGES

rows.label: HELD
rows.sub: as of end of 2025, per OGE disclosures

rows.label: TRADED
rows.sub: 100+ buys and sells, Jan. 2025–Sept. 2026, per disclosures

graphic.note: Bars show the low-to-high range on a $0–$100M scale. Ranges from disclosures filed with the Office of Government Ethics, as reported by CBS News.

quote.text: It’s not the job of the government to call up and say who the CEO of a company should be.
quote.attr: Richard Painter, former White House chief ethics attorney, told CBS News

strip.text: Huang resigns as Nvidia president and CEO, the company announced.
Nvidia’s board reinstates Huang. Trump says he spoke with the board and “convinced them” to rehire him.
Trump on CNBC: “we have to protect our geniuses.”
CBS News reports Trump’s Nvidia holdings and trades from his disclosures.

means.label: Ranges, not exact:
means.text: Disclosures report value ranges, not exact amounts. CBS says it isn’t clear how many Nvidia shares the president currently owns.

means.label: The White House:
means.text: Trump’s portfolio “is independently managed by third-party financial institutions,” and no family member can “direct, influence, or provide input.” It says holdings mirror indexes like the Schwab 1000. Trump has denied any conflict of interest.

means.label: A critic:
means.text: Kathleen Clark, Washington University in St. Louis law professor: “This goes beyond a conflict of interest.”

means.label: On the record:
means.text: The president’s stake and his account of talking to Nvidia’s board are both public. Appointees at State, Commerce, Treasury and the IRS also reported millions in Nvidia stock; many have since sold.

sources: Sources: CBS News (Isabel Vincent), Nov. 25, 2026; Office of Government Ethics financial disclosures (via CBS News); Trump on CNBC, Nov. 23, 2026.
